rounds.prompt: The Milan Cortina 2026 Winter Olympics gave a medal to every athlete on the podium, one each for every member of a winning team. How much did all those medals weigh in total?
rounds.source: Milano Cortina 2026 and the Italian State Mint (IPZS), medal unveiling, July 2025: 245 gold, 245 silver and 245 bronze Olympic medals, weighing 506 g, 500 g and 420 g

rounds.prompt: How much revenue did Apple bring in every minute, on average, in its 2025 fiscal year?
rounds.source: Apple Inc. Form 10-K for fiscal 2025 (SEC filing): net sales of $416,161 million for the 52 weeks ended September 27, 2025

rounds.prompt: How long would it take to watch every official James Bond film back to back, from Dr. No (1962) to No Time to Die (2021)?
rounds.source: Running times of the 25 official Eon Bond films (BBFC, via Wikipedia): 3,208 minutes
